Everything above about "100X Merry MONEY" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1918.headline: Another top prize was claimed

1919.body:
"QUICK WINS" is still new, with most of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Every line of QUICK WINS's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1919.headline: How far along this game is

1921.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES", most is in wins under $600. The game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

Today's free summary of "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
1921.headline: Same price, different prizes

1927.body:
"CASH SCRATCH FEVER" is early in its run, with most of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "CASH SCRATCH FEVER" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1927.headline: Tickets sold so far

1929.body:
A $20,027 top prize on "Cheers 2027" was claimed last week. The game started with seventeen top prizes and has fifteen top prizes left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If "Cheers 2027" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
1929.headline: A top prize was just claimed
